title: Balancing Logit Variation for Long-Tailed Semantic Segmentation
mechanism: Add class-scaled Gaussian noise to logits during training (larger for rare classes) so tail features occupy a region rather than a point; removed at test.
adaptation: Sigma from log inverse pixel frequency over 17 present classes; cap crack sigma at the inactive value (or exclude crack in a second arm) because crack labels are already jittered. One-line head change on U-Net++.
min_experiment: Arm: BLV with crack capped, 3 seeds; baseline SUP100; metric mIoU_rob, splice/edge_dark IoU, crack IoU guard; kill if mIoU_rob < +0.01 or crack IoU drop > 0.01.
evidence: R: gains mostly on tail classes; fully supervised ViT-B UperHead 77.7 mIoU, tail 66.2, ahead of logit adjustment and Lovasz in their comparison table.
